description.value:
You touch a willing creature, granting it a reserve of protective luck. Once before the power ends, the target may roll a d4 and add the result to one saving throw of its choice, after which the power ends.

The die improves with level: a d6 at 5th level, a d8 at 11th level, and a d10 at 17th level.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Universal Powers, At-Will
